mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within two months signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth by more than 1% over two quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings and economic outlook deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods with declining GDP, or the correlation between GDP decline and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% over two months signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings and economic outlook improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 over a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investor sentiment turns bearish.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between PAYEMS decreases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and economic activity rise.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint correlation between HOUST/RSAFS increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a supportive monetary policy and a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decrease > 0.25% and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint correlation between FEDFUNDS/UNRATE decreases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index by more than 2% over three months signals inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded and the Fed may tighten policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
